title: 砂井與垂直排水板~Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains
focus: 徑向排水、塗抹效應與壓密完成度~Radial drainage, smear effects and consolidation completion
summary: 砂井與預製排水板縮短軟土排水路徑，使超額孔壓較快消散，但不會直接消除土的可壓縮性。本課以網格幾何、等效直徑、水平壓密時間與安裝塗抹為主線，連結井阻、載重、沉陷及排水老化，建立以孔壓與變形共同判斷的卸載交接條件。~Sand drains and prefabricated drains shorten drainage paths and accelerate excess-pressure dissipation without eliminating compressibility. The course connects grid geometry, equivalent diameter, radial time and installation smear to well resistance, loading, settlement and drain deterioration, establishing unloading and handover criteria from both pressure and movement.

units.title: 排水距離尺度的機理與驗證~Drainage-length scale mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 排水路徑縮短會加快壓力擴散，理想擴散時間隨特徵長度平方變化，這是垂直排水構想的基礎。實際排水板網格同時改變影響半徑、井徑比與塗抹比例，不能只用長度平方比直接預測現場工期；土層排水方向也需要辨識。本比值特別保持無因次參數不變，並非排水板間距改變後的工期比；實際n、塗抹與井阻會一同變動。~Shorter drainage paths accelerate pressure diffusion, whose ideal characteristic time varies with squared length. This motivates vertical drains, but actual spacing changes influence radius, drain-size ratio and smear proportion together. A length-squared ratio alone therefore cannot predict field schedule, and relevant drainage directions must also be identified. This ratio explicitly holds dimensionless parameters fixed and is not the schedule ratio after changing drain spacing; actual size ratio, smear and well resistance change together.
units.model: 原創教學假設：僅在相同無因次幾何與材料參數的擴散尺度比較，L₁=5 m、L₂=1 m，t₂/t₁=(L₂/L₁)²=0.04。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Only for diffusion scaling with identical dimensionless geometry and material parameters, L₁=5 m and L₂=1 m give t₂/t₁=(L₂/L₁)²=0.04. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以壓密試驗與分層孔壓建立排水方向，對照試驗區時間曲線，檢查塗抹與井阻是否主導。設計者應分開記錄尺度示意與實際徑向壓密模型；卸載須依觀測而非單一平方比例放行。~Use consolidation tests and multilevel pore pressure to define drainage direction, comparing trial-area time histories and checking whether smear or well resistance dominates. The designer separates scaling illustration from actual radial-consolidation modelling; unloading follows observations rather than one squared ratio.
units.failure: 把理想百分之四時間當實際排程，會提前卸除預壓，留下未消散孔壓與後續沉陷。本比值特別保持無因次參數不變，並非排水板間距改變後的工期比；實際n、塗抹與井阻會一同變動。~Using the ideal four-percent time as a schedule can release surcharge early, leaving excess pressure and later settlement. This ratio explicitly holds dimensionless parameters fixed and is not the schedule ratio after changing drain spacing; actual size ratio, smear and well resistance change together.
units.misconception: 排水距離減成五分之一，現場工期一定固定變成百分之四。~Reducing drainage length to one fifth always makes the field duration exactly four percent.
units.practice: 設計者應分開記錄尺度示意與實際徑向壓密模型；卸載須依觀測而非單一平方比例放行。本比值特別保持無因次參數不變，並非排水板間距改變後的工期比；實際n、塗抹與井阻會一同變動。~The designer separates scaling illustration from actual radial-consolidation modelling; unloading follows observations rather than one squared ratio. This ratio explicitly holds dimensionless parameters fixed and is not the schedule ratio after changing drain spacing; actual size ratio, smear and well resistance change together.

units.anchor: 三角網格影響徑~Triangular-grid influence diameter
units.title: 三角網格影響徑的機理與驗證~Triangular-grid influence diameter mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 排水板網格把土體分成單井影響單元，等效圓面積用於徑向壓密分析。三角形與方形排列有不同的面積換算，施工偏位及漏插又會形成較大未排水區；名目間距需要與實際安裝位置一起驗證。係數一點零五是等面積近似，不描述邊界單元或排水不均；異常網格應以實際幾何重新建立模型。~A drain grid divides soil into influence cells, represented by equivalent circular area in radial analysis. Triangular and square layouts use different area conversions, while misplaced or omitted drains create larger undrained zones. Nominal spacing therefore requires verification against actual installation positions rather than reliance on the layout drawing alone. The coefficient is an equal-area approximation, not a model of boundary cells or uneven drainage; irregular grids require revised geometry.
units.model: 原創教學假設：三角形網格假設間距s=1.2 m，等效影響直徑de≈1.05s=1.26 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For a triangular grid with spacing s=1.2 m, equivalent influence diameter de≈1.05s=1.26 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 將實際插設座標與設計網格疊合，檢查邊界、障礙物及漏插區，計算最不利單元面積。竣工網格須保留實際位置與未完成深度；地工設計者核定補插及監測點代表性後才驗收。~Overlay actual installation coordinates on the design grid, checking boundaries, obstacles and omissions and calculating adverse influence-cell areas. As-built grids retain actual positions and incomplete depths; the geotechnical designer approves additional drains and monitoring representativeness before acceptance.
units.failure: 漏插或偏位可能留下排水盲區，周圍測點反應良好仍無法代表該局部壓密程度。係數一點零五是等面積近似，不描述邊界單元或排水不均；異常網格應以實際幾何重新建立模型。~Omission or displacement leaves a drainage blind zone that favourable surrounding measurements do not represent. The coefficient is an equal-area approximation, not a model of boundary cells or uneven drainage; irregular grids require revised geometry.
units.misconception: 三角與方形網格可以無條件用相同的等效直徑係數。~Triangular and square grids can always use the same influence-diameter coefficient.
units.practice: 竣工網格須保留實際位置與未完成深度；地工設計者核定補插及監測點代表性後才驗收。係數一點零五是等面積近似，不描述邊界單元或排水不均；異常網格應以實際幾何重新建立模型。~As-built grids retain actual positions and incomplete depths; the geotechnical designer approves additional drains and monitoring representativeness before acceptance. The coefficient is an equal-area approximation, not a model of boundary cells or uneven drainage; irregular grids require revised geometry.

units.anchor: 帶狀排水板等效徑~Equivalent band-drain diameter
units.title: 帶狀排水板等效徑的機理與驗證~Equivalent band-drain diameter mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 排水板是帶狀而非圓管，徑向土體分析常以等效圓直徑表示其周長效果。寬度與厚度之外，濾布透水性、芯材通道及受壓後變形都影響排水，幾何等效不等於水力容量等效，也不能直接套用砂井直徑。等周長式屬模型近似，不是流道內徑；受壓排水能力及土體濾層相容性需要獨立的水力試驗。~Band drains are not circular pipes, so radial soil analysis commonly uses an equivalent diameter related to perimeter. Width and thickness do not capture filter permeability, core channels or compression. Geometric equivalence therefore is not hydraulic-capacity equivalence and cannot be substituted directly for a sand-drain diameter. The perimeter relation is a modelling approximation, not internal channel diameter; confined discharge and soil-filter compatibility need separate hydraulic tests.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設帶寬b=0.10 m、厚t=0.004 m，等周長等效dw=2(b+t)/π=0.0662 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For width b=0.10 m and thickness t=0.004 m, perimeter-equivalent dw=2(b+t)/π=0.0662 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 核對產品尺寸與受圍壓排水試驗，檢查彎折後通道及濾布狀態，分列等效直徑與通水量。材料驗收應核對受壓、彎折及濾布試驗條件；設計者確認與實際土壓及沉陷相符後才採用。~Verify product dimensions and confined-flow tests, inspect channels and filter after bending, and report equivalent diameter separately from discharge capacity. Acceptance checks confinement, bending and filter test conditions; the designer confirms their relevance to actual earth pressure and settlement before use.
units.failure: 只按等效直徑選材可能忽略芯材壓潰或濾布堵塞，實際井阻遠大於設計假設。等周長式屬模型近似，不是流道內徑；受壓排水能力及土體濾層相容性需要獨立的水力試驗。~Selecting by equivalent diameter alone can miss crushed cores or clogged filters, producing much greater well resistance than assumed. The perimeter relation is a modelling approximation, not internal channel diameter; confined discharge and soil-filter compatibility need separate hydraulic tests.
units.misconception: 等效直徑相同的排水板就一定有相同通水能力。~Drains with the same equivalent diameter have identical discharge capacity.
units.practice: 材料驗收應核對受壓、彎折及濾布試驗條件；設計者確認與實際土壓及沉陷相符後才採用。等周長式屬模型近似，不是流道內徑；受壓排水能力及土體濾層相容性需要獨立的水力試驗。~Acceptance checks confinement, bending and filter test conditions; the designer confirms their relevance to actual earth pressure and settlement before use. The perimeter relation is a modelling approximation, not internal channel diameter; confined discharge and soil-filter compatibility need separate hydraulic tests.

units.anchor: 徑向時間因子~Radial time factor
units.title: 徑向時間因子的機理與驗證~Radial time factor mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 徑向壓密的時間因子把水平壓密係數、時間及單井影響尺寸結合，便於比較不同觀測時段。它本身不是壓密完成度，還需井徑比、塗抹與井阻的函數；水平係數也不能無條件用垂直壓密試驗值替代。本算例明確使用平方公尺每一天，時間亦以天計；要從Tr求壓密度，還必須指定所採理論及全部無因次參數。~The radial time factor combines horizontal consolidation coefficient, time and cell size to compare observation periods. It is not itself degree of consolidation, which also depends on drain-size ratio, smear and well resistance. Horizontal coefficients cannot automatically be replaced by vertical-test values without justification of anisotropy. This example explicitly uses square metres per day and time in days; converting Tr to consolidation degree still requires the selected theory and all dimensionless parameters.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設ch=0.01 m²/day、t=100 day、de=1.26 m，Tr=ch t/de²=0.630，無因次。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For ch=0.01 m²/day, t=100 day and de=1.26 m, Tr=ch t/de²=0.630, dimensionless. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以試驗區孔壓及沉陷曲線反算ch範圍，保留獨立測點驗證，確認時間單位與係數完全一致。計算書須標示ch的試驗方向、單位與應力範圍；地工設計者核准完整壓密函數後再作排程推估。~Back-analyse a range of ch from trial-area pressure and settlement, retain independent validation points, and verify consistent time units in all coefficients. State ch direction, units and stress range; the geotechnical designer approves the full consolidation function before schedule estimation.
units.failure: 把日與秒混用會造成巨大工期誤差，把Tr當完成率則會在機制尚未確認時提前卸載。本算例明確使用平方公尺每一天，時間亦以天計；要從Tr求壓密度，還必須指定所採理論及全部無因次參數。~Mixing days and seconds creates major schedule errors, while treating Tr as completion percentage can release surcharge before the mechanism is verified. This example explicitly uses square metres per day and time in days; converting Tr to consolidation degree still requires the selected theory and all dimensionless parameters.
units.misconception: 徑向時間因子等於零點六三就代表完成百分之六十三。~A radial time factor of 0.63 means sixty-three-percent consolidation.
units.practice: 計算書須標示ch的試驗方向、單位與應力範圍；地工設計者核准完整壓密函數後再作排程推估。本算例明確使用平方公尺每一天，時間亦以天計；要從Tr求壓密度，還必須指定所採理論及全部無因次參數。~State ch direction, units and stress range; the geotechnical designer approves the full consolidation function before schedule estimation. This example explicitly uses square metres per day and time in days; converting Tr to consolidation degree still requires the selected theory and all dimensionless parameters.

units.title: 塗抹區滲透性的機理與驗證~Smear-zone permeability mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 插設套管擾動排水板周圍土體，可能重塑黏土並形成低水平滲透性的塗抹區。排水路徑雖變短，水仍需穿越這個局部阻力；因此增加排水板數量不一定按理想比例加速壓密，工具尺寸與土體敏感性需共同考慮。滲透比不足以完整描述塗抹效應，還需要塗抹區尺寸與原土各向異性；不能把本比值當普遍材料常數。~Installation mandrels disturb surrounding soil, potentially remoulding clay into a zone of lower horizontal permeability. Although the drainage path shortens, water must still cross this local resistance. More drains therefore need not accelerate consolidation by the ideal proportion, and tool size and soil sensitivity must be considered together. Permeability ratio alone does not define smear; its extent and native-soil anisotropy are also needed, and this ratio is not universal.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設塗抹區ks=1×10⁻⁹ m/s、未擾動kh=5×10⁻⁹ m/s，比值ks/kh=0.20。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For smear permeability ks=1×10⁻⁹ m/s and undisturbed kh=5×10⁻⁹ m/s, ks/kh=0.20. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 比較靠近及遠離排水板的孔壓消散，核對套管尺寸與土體重塑試驗，辨識塗抹半徑和滲透性的不確定度。安裝設備與套管尺寸變更需重審塗抹假設；地工設計者以試驗區反應核定實際設計參數。~Compare dissipation near and away from drains, verify mandrel dimensions and remoulding tests, and assess uncertainty in smear radius and permeability. Changing installation equipment or mandrel size requires review of smear assumptions; the geotechnical designer approves parameters using trial-area response.
units.failure: 忽略塗抹會高估排水速率，試驗區尚未達預期便需重新解釋模型，而非只增加預壓荷重。滲透比不足以完整描述塗抹效應，還需要塗抹區尺寸與原土各向異性；不能把本比值當普遍材料常數。~Ignoring smear overpredicts drainage rate; underperforming trials require model reassessment rather than merely adding surcharge. Permeability ratio alone does not define smear; its extent and native-soil anisotropy are also needed, and this ratio is not universal.
units.misconception: 插設擾動只影響施工方便，對長期排水速度沒有影響。~Installation disturbance affects convenience but not long-term drainage rate.
units.practice: 安裝設備與套管尺寸變更需重審塗抹假設；地工設計者以試驗區反應核定實際設計參數。滲透比不足以完整描述塗抹效應，還需要塗抹區尺寸與原土各向異性；不能把本比值當普遍材料常數。~Changing installation equipment or mandrel size requires review of smear assumptions; the geotechnical designer approves parameters using trial-area response. Permeability ratio alone does not define smear; its extent and native-soil anisotropy are also needed, and this ratio is not universal.

units.title: 排水井阻的機理與驗證~Well resistance mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 水進入排水板後還必須沿芯材向排水層流動，長排水板、圍壓及彎折可能造成顯著井阻。把排水板當成零水頭損失邊界會高估深部排水，砂墊層及出口不暢也可能限制整個系統，需分辨土內阻力與排水通道阻力。這是指定工況的等效阻力而非材料常數，與長度、圍壓及流量條件有關；井阻模型需保留實際排水方向。~After entering the drain, water travels along the core to an outlet. Long drains, confinement and bending can create significant well resistance. Assuming zero drain head loss overestimates deep drainage, while a restricted blanket or outlet can govern the whole system. Distinguish soil resistance from resistance inside the drainage path. This is equivalent resistance for one condition, not a material constant; length, confinement and flow matter, and the well-resistance model must retain the actual drainage direction.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設水頭損失Δh=2 m、流量Q=0.0001 m³/s，等效水力阻力R=Δh/Q=20000 s/m²。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For head loss Δh=2 m and discharge Q=0.0001 m³/s, hydraulic resistance R=Δh/Q=20000 s/m². This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 量測排水通道上不同高程水頭並核對出水量，將受壓通水試驗與現場彎折及沉陷條件比較。交接須含排水墊層與出口通達性；地工及排水設計者確認整條流路後才接受排水系統。~Measure heads at different elevations along the drainage path and outlet flow, comparing confined discharge tests with field bending and settlement. Handover includes drainage blankets and outlet access; geotechnical and drainage designers confirm the entire path before accepting the system.
units.failure: 出口堵塞或芯材壓縮會讓深部孔壓消散落後，表層沉陷較快也不能證明全深有效排水。這是指定工況的等效阻力而非材料常數，與長度、圍壓及流量條件有關；井阻模型需保留實際排水方向。~A blocked outlet or compressed core delays deep pressure dissipation, and rapid shallow settlement does not prove effective full-depth drainage. This is equivalent resistance for one condition, not a material constant; length, confinement and flow matter, and the well-resistance model must retain the actual drainage direction.
units.misconception: 水進入排水板後就沒有任何沿程水頭損失。~Water experiences no head loss after entering a vertical drain.
units.practice: 交接須含排水墊層與出口通達性；地工及排水設計者確認整條流路後才接受排水系統。這是指定工況的等效阻力而非材料常數，與長度、圍壓及流量條件有關；井阻模型需保留實際排水方向。~Handover includes drainage blankets and outlet access; geotechnical and drainage designers confirm the entire path before accepting the system. This is equivalent resistance for one condition, not a material constant; length, confinement and flow matter, and the well-resistance model must retain the actual drainage direction.

units.title: 有效應力成長的機理與驗證~Effective-stress gain mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 預壓荷載初期可主要轉成超額孔壓，隨排水消散，更多荷載才移交給土骨架並引起壓密。若只量測地表荷重而沒有孔壓，就不能判定有效應力增加多少；水位變化與不同土層的初始壓力也需用同一基準處理。增量式需同一位置與時刻且正負號一致，不能把絕對孔壓混入超額孔壓；總應力分布還受荷載擴散影響。~Surcharge may initially appear mainly as excess pore pressure; drainage progressively transfers more load to the skeleton and causes consolidation. Applied surface load alone cannot establish effective-stress gain without pressure observations. Groundwater changes and layer-specific initial pressures also require one consistent reference. The increment relation requires the same location, time and sign convention; absolute and excess pressures are not interchangeable, and total stress also reflects load spread.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設總應力增量Δσ=80 kPa、殘餘超額孔壓Δu=30 kPa，Δσ′=Δσ−Δu=50 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For total-stress increment Δσ=80 kPa and remaining excess pressure Δu=30 kPa, effective increment Δσ′=Δσ−Δu=50 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以多深度孔壓與預壓高程核對荷載歷程，確認儀器基準水壓及地下水位變化，分層求有效增量。每階段荷載與孔壓應同步歸檔；地工設計者確認有效應力及穩定需求後才核准加載或卸載。~Use multilevel pore pressure and surcharge elevation to reconstruct load history, checking baseline pressure and groundwater changes before calculating layer-wise effective increments. Archive each loading stage with synchronized pore pressures; the geotechnical designer confirms effective stress and stability requirements before loading or unloading.
units.failure: 把預壓全重當成已完成有效應力，會高估土體強度及壓密度，卸載後留下可觀後續沉陷。增量式需同一位置與時刻且正負號一致，不能把絕對孔壓混入超額孔壓；總應力分布還受荷載擴散影響。~Treating all surcharge as mobilized effective stress overstates strength and consolidation and can leave substantial later settlement after unloading. The increment relation requires the same location, time and sign convention; absolute and excess pressures are not interchangeable, and total stress also reflects load spread.
units.misconception: 加上八十千帕預壓，就立刻增加八十千帕有效應力。~Applying eighty kilopascals of surcharge immediately adds the same effective stress.
units.practice: 每階段荷載與孔壓應同步歸檔；地工設計者確認有效應力及穩定需求後才核准加載或卸載。增量式需同一位置與時刻且正負號一致，不能把絕對孔壓混入超額孔壓；總應力分布還受荷載擴散影響。~Archive each loading stage with synchronized pore pressures; the geotechnical designer confirms effective stress and stability requirements before loading or unloading. The increment relation requires the same location, time and sign convention; absolute and excess pressures are not interchangeable, and total stress also reflects load spread.

units.anchor: 對數壓縮沉陷~Logarithmic compression settlement
units.title: 對數壓縮沉陷的機理與驗證~Logarithmic compression settlement mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 正常壓密黏土在一維條件下可用壓縮指數與有效應力對數關係估算沉陷，排水板主要改變到達此沉陷的速度而非終值。若存在先期壓密、不同應力路徑或次壓密，需分段採用相應參數，不能把一條正常壓密線套用所有土層。此式明定正常壓密、一維及以十為底對數，未含側移；Cc為無因次斜率，不能與以自然對數定義的參數混用。~For normally consolidated clay in one-dimensional conditions, compression index and logarithmic effective stress estimate settlement. Drains mainly change how quickly settlement occurs rather than its ultimate value. Preconsolidation, different stress paths and secondary compression require appropriate segments and parameters instead of one virgin-compression line for every layer. The formula specifies normally consolidated one-dimensional behaviour and base-ten logarithms, excluding lateral movement; dimensionless Cc cannot be mixed with a natural-log parameter.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設Cc=0.3、H=10 m、e₀=1.0、σ′₀=100 kPa、σ′f=150 kPa，s=CcH/(1+e₀) log₁₀(σ′f/σ′₀)=0.264 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For Cc=0.3, H=10 m, e₀=1.0, σ′₀=100 kPa and σ′f=150 kPa, s=CcH/(1+e₀) log₁₀(σ′f/σ′₀)=0.264 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以壓密試驗核對先期壓密壓力與指數，使用分層沉陷計比較，確認應力增量及厚度代表性。設計與交接應分開主要壓密及長期次壓密預測；地工設計者確認參數適用應力範圍後再解讀監測。~Check preconsolidation pressure and indices from consolidation tests, compare layered settlement, and verify representative stress increments and thicknesses. Separate primary and secondary settlement in design and handover; the geotechnical designer confirms parameter stress ranges before interpreting monitoring.
units.failure: 誤把超壓密土全程用正常壓密指數，可能高估或錯估沉陷；忽略次壓密則會漏掉長期變形。此式明定正常壓密、一維及以十為底對數，未含側移；Cc為無因次斜率，不能與以自然對數定義的參數混用。~Applying virgin compression throughout an overconsolidated path mispredicts settlement, while neglecting secondary compression misses long-term movement. The formula specifies normally consolidated one-dimensional behaviour and base-ten logarithms, excluding lateral movement; dimensionless Cc cannot be mixed with a natural-log parameter.
units.misconception: 裝設排水板會把軟土的最終壓縮沉陷直接消除。~Installing vertical drains directly eliminates ultimate compressive settlement of soft soil.
units.practice: 設計與交接應分開主要壓密及長期次壓密預測；地工設計者確認參數適用應力範圍後再解讀監測。此式明定正常壓密、一維及以十為底對數，未含側移；Cc為無因次斜率，不能與以自然對數定義的參數混用。~Separate primary and secondary settlement in design and handover; the geotechnical designer confirms parameter stress ranges before interpreting monitoring. The formula specifies normally consolidated one-dimensional behaviour and base-ten logarithms, excluding lateral movement; dimensionless Cc cannot be mixed with a natural-log parameter.

units.title: 排水能力衰減的機理與驗證~Discharge-capacity deterioration mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 排水板隨土體沉陷彎折、圍壓增加或濾布堵塞，通水能力可能下降，因此出廠直條試驗不足以代表全工期。衰減比例應在相同水力坡降與圍壓下比較，才能辨別材料性能改變；現場出水下降也可能單純因超額孔壓已減少。百分比只對相同試驗邊界成立，不能把不同水頭下的流量直接比較；通水衰減也不等於壓密速度同比下降。~Drain bending during settlement, rising confinement and filter clogging can reduce discharge, so a straight factory test does not represent the whole project. Compare deterioration at consistent gradient and confinement to identify material change. Falling field discharge may instead reflect reduced excess pressure and must not automatically be called clogging. The percentage requires identical test boundaries; flow at different heads is not directly comparable, and capacity loss does not imply proportional slowing of consolidation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：在相同試驗條件下，通水量Q₀=100 L/h降至Q₁=70 L/h，衰減(Q₀−Q₁)/Q₀=30%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Under identical test conditions, discharge falls from Q₀=100 L/h to Q₁=70 L/h, giving deterioration of 30%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以受壓彎折試驗比較前後通水量，現場則同步看孔壓與排水量，區分能力下降及驅動水頭減少。材料試驗需涵蓋預期圍壓與變形；地工設計者核定能力折減，營運端保留出口維護與監測責任。~Compare confined bent-drain discharge before and after conditioning; in the field assess pressure and flow together to distinguish capacity loss from reduced driving head. Material tests cover anticipated confinement and deformation; the geotechnical designer approves capacity reduction while operators retain outlet-maintenance and monitoring responsibility.
units.failure: 忽略彎折與堵塞會讓深部排水變慢，若只按初始材料性能安排卸載，就可能留下殘餘孔壓。百分比只對相同試驗邊界成立，不能把不同水頭下的流量直接比較；通水衰減也不等於壓密速度同比下降。~Ignoring bending and clogging slows deep drainage; unloading based only on initial material performance can leave residual pressure. The percentage requires identical test boundaries; flow at different heads is not directly comparable, and capacity loss does not imply proportional slowing of consolidation.
units.misconception: 現場出水量減少就一定表示排水板已經堵塞。~Reduced field discharge necessarily means the drain has clogged.
units.practice: 材料試驗需涵蓋預期圍壓與變形；地工設計者核定能力折減，營運端保留出口維護與監測責任。百分比只對相同試驗邊界成立，不能把不同水頭下的流量直接比較；通水衰減也不等於壓密速度同比下降。~Material tests cover anticipated confinement and deformation; the geotechnical designer approves capacity reduction while operators retain outlet-maintenance and monitoring responsibility. The percentage requires identical test boundaries; flow at different heads is not directly comparable, and capacity loss does not imply proportional slowing of consolidation.

units.anchor: 壓密度與卸載~Consolidation and unloading
units.title: 壓密度與卸載的機理與驗證~Consolidation and unloading mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 由實測沉陷除以估計最終主要壓密沉陷，可得到沉陷定義的平均壓密度，但分母本身有模型不確定度。地表沉陷可能混入側移或次壓密，孔壓定義的完成度也未必一致；卸載必須用多種證據確認剩餘變形符合資產需求。此壓密度以可靠的主要壓密終值為前提，不是通用卸載門檻；若終值重估，比例及殘餘沉陷都必須一起更新。~Measured settlement divided by estimated ultimate primary settlement gives a settlement-based average consolidation degree, but its denominator is uncertain. Surface settlement may include lateral movement or secondary compression, and a pressure-based degree need not match exactly. Unloading therefore requires multiple evidence streams that confirm tolerable residual movement. This degree assumes a reliable ultimate primary settlement and is not a universal unloading threshold; revised ultimate estimates require updating both the ratio and residual settlement.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設已發生主要壓密沉陷s=240 mm、估計終值s∞=300 mm，Us=s/s∞=0.80=80%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For measured primary settlement s=240 mm and estimated ultimate s∞=300 mm, Us=s/s∞=0.80=80%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 比較沉陷外推與多深度孔壓消散，檢查最終沉陷估算對資料時窗的敏感度，保留未達標層位。卸載移交應由地工設計者及資產管理者共同核准，列明剩餘沉陷、回彈及長期監測條件。~Compare settlement extrapolation with multilevel pressure dissipation, test sensitivity of ultimate-settlement estimates to the data window, and retain unresolved layers explicitly. The geotechnical designer and asset owner jointly approve unloading and handover, documenting residual settlement, rebound and long-term monitoring conditions.
units.failure: 高估已完成比例會提前移除預壓，營運載重後再產生沉陷；只用地表平均可能漏掉深部未壓密層。此壓密度以可靠的主要壓密終值為前提，不是通用卸載門檻；若終值重估，比例及殘餘沉陷都必須一起更新。~Overstating completion releases surcharge early and permits later settlement; surface averages can miss deep unconsolidated layers. This degree assumes a reliable ultimate primary settlement and is not a universal unloading threshold; revised ultimate estimates require updating both the ratio and residual settlement.
units.misconception: 地表沉陷看似停止就表示所有深度的孔壓都消散。~Apparently stopped surface settlement proves pore pressure has dissipated at every depth.
units.practice: 卸載移交應由地工設計者及資產管理者共同核准，列明剩餘沉陷、回彈及長期監測條件。此壓密度以可靠的主要壓密終值為前提，不是通用卸載門檻；若終值重估，比例及殘餘沉陷都必須一起更新。~The geotechnical designer and asset owner jointly approve unloading and handover, documenting residual settlement, rebound and long-term monitoring conditions. This degree assumes a reliable ultimate primary settlement and is not a universal unloading threshold; revised ultimate estimates require updating both the ratio and residual settlement.

example: 原創教學例：僅作固定無因次幾何與材料參數的擴散尺度比較，長路徑Llong=5 m、短路徑Lshort=1 m，時間比tshort/tlong=(1/5)²=0.0400。若短路徑增加10%至1.1 m，時間比變為(1.1/5)²=0.0484，比原比值增加21%。這不是排水板網格改變後的實際工期比例，因為井徑比、塗抹範圍及井阻可能同步改變。工程設計仍須用完整徑向壓密關係並配合孔壓、沉陷與排水能力觀測，確認各層剩餘壓密而非直接套用平方比。~Original teaching example: compare diffusion scales only while holding dimensionless geometry and material parameters fixed. With Llong=5 m and Lshort=1 m, tshort/tlong=(1/5)²=0.0400. Increasing the short length by 10% to 1.1 m changes the ratio to (1.1/5)²=0.0484, a 21% increase in that ratio. This is not the actual schedule ratio after changing a drain grid, because drain-size ratio, smear extent and well resistance may change simultaneously. Engineering design still requires the complete radial-consolidation relationship and observations of pore pressure, settlement and discharge capacity to establish residual consolidation in each layer.
history: 砂井與預製排水板縮短軟土排水路徑，使超額孔壓較快消散，但不會直接消除土的可壓縮性。本課以網格幾何、等效直徑、水平壓密時間與安裝塗抹為主線，連結井阻、載重、沉陷及排水老化，建立以孔壓與變形共同判斷的卸載交接條件。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。~Sand drains and prefabricated drains shorten drainage paths and accelerate excess-pressure dissipation without eliminating compressibility. The course connects grid geometry, equivalent diameter, radial time and installation smear to well resistance, loading, settlement and drain deterioration, establishing unloading and handover criteria from both pressure and movement. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
facts: 合成教學假設：僅在相同無因次幾何與材料參數的擴散尺度比較，L₁=5 m、L₂=1 m，t₂/t₁=(L₂/L₁)²=0.04~Synthetic teaching assumptions: Only for diffusion scaling with identical dimensionless geometry and material parameters, L₁=5 m and L₂=1 m give t₂/t₁=(L₂/L₁)²=0.04
合成教學假設：三角形網格假設間距s=1.2 m，等效影響直徑de≈1.05s=1.26 m~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For a triangular grid with spacing s=1.2 m, equivalent influence diameter de≈1.05s=1.26 m
合成教學假設：假設帶寬b=0.10 m、厚t=0.004 m，等周長等效dw=2(b+t)/π=0.0662 m~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For width b=0.10 m and thickness t=0.004 m, perimeter-equivalent dw=2(b+t)/π=0.0662 m

合成教學假設：假設塗抹區ks=1×10⁻⁹ m/s、未擾動kh=5×10⁻⁹ m/s，比值ks/kh=0.20~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For smear permeability ks=1×10⁻⁹ m/s and undisturbed kh=5×10⁻⁹ m/s, ks/kh=0.20
